Niti Aayog Proposes National Caregiving Policy to Boost Economy and Workforce

Niti Aayog has proposed a national caregiving policy aimed at professionalizing the care sector. The policy seeks to improve care for the elderly, disabled, and those needing long-term support. It is also intended to generate employment, increase women's participation in the labor force, and position India as a global provider of trained caregivers, leveraging a worldwide shortage in the sector.
